Record Class RecruitmentStepsService.RankingProgress

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
edu.ucsb.cs.taapply.services.RecruitmentStepsService.RankingProgress
Record Components:
courses - the courses counted: those not removed with an allocation of at least 1, since a course allocated no one needs no rankings
coursesWithMinimum - the courses counted that have the minimum rankings: at least as many as their share of the hiring target (their allocation)
coursesWithRequested - the courses counted that have the requested rankings: at least CourseTargetsService.requestedRankings(int) (twice the allocation)
requestedRankingsPerPosition - the factor itself, CourseTargetsService.REQUESTED_RANKINGS_PER_POSITION, so the thermometer's label can name it without defining it a second time
Enclosing class:
RecruitmentStepsService
public static record RecruitmentStepsService.RankingProgress(int courses, int coursesWithMinimum, int coursesWithRequested, int requestedRankingsPerPosition) extends Record
How far faculty ranking has got (issue #453), for the thermometer on the admin's recruitment card.
